core_weaknesses.title: Sensitivity to uninformative local descriptors
core_weaknesses.description: The class score aggregates many local nearest-neighbor matches without evidence in this synthetic fixture that every descriptor is equally discriminative.
core_weaknesses.why_it_matters: If background or weak descriptors receive high-similarity neighbors, they can contribute misleading evidence to the final class score.
core_weaknesses.potential_impact: The central claim that local matching improves classification may weaken under clutter, domain shift, or fine-grained ambiguity.
core_weaknesses.suggested_validation: Inject descriptor noise or mask foreground/background regions while holding the backbone and support set fixed, then measure class-score and accuracy sensitivity.
